applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
## Store name and address

Use the name associated with the store's `myshopify.com` address. For `yourstore.myshopify.com`, the name is `yourstore`. An incorrect name or URL is one possible cause of “Sorry, this shop is currently unavailable”; the message alone does not establish a unique cause.

## Authorization routes

For a Shopify independent-store account, open Store Management, select the store and use the authorization entry. Shopify Payments supports authorization from CedarPay or through the CedarPay application in Shopify.

For the Shopify application route:

1. Find and install the CedarPay application in the Shopify app store.
2. Sign in to CedarPay when prompted.
3. Select the store and complete authorization.

## Quota processing

Authorization normally processes sales records from the preceding 1–180 days within about 24 hours. Shopify also supports manual sales-record upload. Use the upload format for the selected platform; Shopify Payments exports must follow their platform-specific guide.

For a shortfall after 24 hours, provide the original sales records, seller ID and collection account to support. Select the Portal account type corresponding to Shopify Payments or the independent-store arrangement actually used.
title: Shopify authorization: store details and connection routes
